name: Paper Boat Lychee Drink
ingredients_raw: WATER, SUGAR, LYCHEE PULP (12%), APPLE JUICE CONCENTRATE (0.5%)*, ACIDITY REGULATORS [330, 332(ii), 331 (iii)], FLAVOURS (NATURE-IDENTICAL AND NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES), STABILIZERS (CARRAGEENAN AND KONJAC FLOUR), ANTIOXIDANT (300) AND VITAMIN D2.
